gloss: half-fledged; inexperienced; not yet fully competent

definitions.gloss: half-fledged; inexperienced; not yet fully competent
definitions.explanation: Describes someone whose skills, knowledge, or maturity have not yet reached a fully independent or professional level.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{半人前|はんにんまえ}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}らない→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧。
examples.english: I'm still only half-fledged, so I need to work harder.

examples.japanese: {半人前|はんにんまえ}のうち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}け→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: While you're still inexperienced, listen to what your seniors say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{一人前|いちにんまえ}→一人前：06782_ichininmae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{半人前|はんにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Before becoming a full-fledged cook, there are years of being only half-trained.

notes:
Literally 'half a person's portion,' contrasting with ⟦{一人前|いちにんまえ}→一人前：06782_ichininmae⟧ (a full portion; fully competent). Originally referred to half a serving of food, but now primarily used figuratively to describe someone not yet at a professional or adult level. Often used in the context of apprenticeship and skill development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{半人前|はんにんまえ}: still only half-fledged
- {半人前|はんにんまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: a half-trained craftsman
- {半人前|はんにんまえ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一人前|いちにんまえ}→一人前：06782_ichininmae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go from half-trained to fully competent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一人前|いちにんまえ}→一人前：06782_ichininmae⟧: fully competent; full-fledged — the opposite, describing someone who has reached a professional or adult level
- ⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧: immature, unskilled — a more general and slightly harsher term for lack of skill or maturity
- ⟦{駆|か}け{出|だ}し→駆け出し：09078_kakedashi⟧: beginner, novice — emphasizes being at the very start, while {半人前|はんにんまえ} suggests some progress but not enough
